<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# verify current geometry
fr=current_frame
line=None; X=None; D=None
for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']>40:
        b=n['boundary']
        line=(min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    if n['color']=='R' and 100<n['pixels']<200:
        b=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if r1-r0>20 and c1-c0<25 and c0<20: X=((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2)
        elif c0>30: D=((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2)
print("line(r0,r1,c0,c1):",line,"X:",X,"D:",D)
# move line: 13 UP + 1 LEFT
res=action(['UP']*13+['LEFT'])
print("done", res.get('board_changed'), res.get('level_completed'))
fr2=current_frame
for n in fr2.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='W':
        b=n['boundary']; print("W now:", min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
    if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']>40:
        b=n['boundary']
        print("line now:", min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
print("level", fr2.level, "step", fr2.step)
